<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in server/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Tools for the OIDC sign-in, working against the loaded configuration file and the server's database. echo mints a one-time link that shows whoever opens it the claims their identity provider sends.

## Synopsis

```
ssoosshd identity [command] [flags]
```

## Global options

Inherited from [`ssoosshd`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoosshd/) and its parents.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to the ssoosshd config file |

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`ssoosshd identity echo`](/ssoossh/reference/cli/ssoosshd/identity-echo/) | Mint a one-time link that shows your identity provider's claims, for first setup. |
